name: Clockwork Cleanser
description: A construct made from gears and metal with the purpose of cleansing organic creautures with fire with a large flamethrower attachment built into it's arm. Clockwork creatures are powered by an internal conduit which can focus beams of energy to deal damage.

actions.name: Flame Purge
actions.description: The Clockwork Cleanser uses it's flamethrower attachment to shoot fire in a 3 unit cone, dealing fire damage. On a true hit, affected creatures are also ignited.

actions.name: Metal Fist
actions.description: The Clockwork Cleanser strikes a creature with it's metal fist, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Extermination Protocol
actions.description: The Clockwork Cleanser marks a target for extermination. For the next minute, or until another target is designated by this action, the Clockwork Cleanser can use it's heat beam free action against that creature.

actions.name: Heat Beam
actions.description: The Clockwork Cleanser fires a beam of concentrated heat at a target designated by extermination protocol, dealing fire damage.

actions.name: Damage Control
actions.description: In response to taking damage, the Clockwork Cleanser shuts down. At the end of it's next turn, if it still has health remaining, it explodes, dealing physical and fire damage in a 3 unit radius.

traits.name: Overcharge
traits.description: If the Clockwork Cleanser takes more than 20 lightning damage after mitigation, it becomes stunned. If it takes more than 30 lightning damage, it is destroyed.
